browser.execution_scope: Playwright editor browser regression; captured source snapshot does not imply C++ execution

local.hash_policy: known text extensions use recorded sha256_lf; binary inputs use recorded raw sha256; output hashes are exact Git blob hashes
local.scope_note: Core source snapshots cover portable C/C++ inputs and named included cases; matching extra case hashes is not Objective-C++ execution. Assets/browser comparison uses explicit command dependencies, excluding unrelated C++ captured by their broad recorder. Prior assets/browser attempts are retained unchanged; release metadata was generated/tested in assets, not core.

fishing.method: Optimized local Windows MinGW C/C++ build and fixed 19-call shared-solver experiment per attempt; final source commit association separately verified.
fishing.before_source_identity: The first attempt source-hashes.json matched its worktree; original raw results and timing remain unchanged.
fishing.after_source_identity: 72 committed source/data files compared with compiled byte manifest; CRLF-to-LF normalization only; no mismatches.

bounds.source_change: For >=4 baseline plans of one L allocation, first plan weight N-1 and every later plan weight 1. Same overall deadline/beam, retained inventories, and geometry one-third stage.

checks: Independent per-step token and all-metadata swaps
All six selected source colors, or 36 target/shared combinations with untouched sources
Independent full-run marking, same-color marked-group flood-fill, exact T/four detection

limitations: Three-spinner cells 2/5/29 are a synthetic variant; the original second-layer spinner locations were not retained.
All 12 synthetic three-spinner calls remain unsolved. Deeper partial routes are not executable success.
The successful route meets the retained light-T and heart-four goals; no claim about unrecorded enemy conditions or kill damage.
13 seconds is from the retained game log; settling/input margins are existing planner assumptions, not measured device timing.
Local wall times depend on this host and test conditions; this is not an iPhone benchmark or on-device gesture verification.
Token identities and coordinates are synthetic; original board colors and orb metadata were copied exactly.
This finite comparison does not prove general success rate, globally optimal routes, or no regression on unseen boards.

reviewed_screenshots.observations: Local narrow-page screenshot inspected at reduced preview size; section flow fits width. Fine text not exhaustively inspected.
Local failure message and retained-draft state visible; save action remains visible.
CI team selection, saved state, six slots and fixed save controls readable with no material overlap of actions.
CI write-failure and retained-draft text visible above team editor; save control remains available.
Simulator summary readable, scroll area and fixed save action visible; expected full-library validation error stays above action.
Legacy simulator restart displays saved Team B with six native portraits and equipment; save control visible.
Simulator route overlay, current step, board and execution controls render clearly.

visual.scope: Visual inspection of selected browser and iOS Simulator screenshots only; all four GUI runs passed automated reports. Screenshots do not verify actual PAD fishing or touch timing.

scope.native_multi_exchange_executor: compiled; model, native snapshot and fake-engine Session tests passed; actual device pending
scope.recorded_turn11: shared solver solved 3/3 balanced and 3/3 thorough; independent replay and all-phase oracle passed
scope.three_spinner_variant: synthetic cells 2/5/29 remain unsolved in the tested budgets; missing real second-layer board not reconstructed
